summary: Waterview Estates: native late interest (Declaration 6.11: 10% per annum, 30-day grace, assessment principal only, GL 4030, prior-month-end calculation cutoff) and Kat bank reconciliation for Operating Checking and Savings (the interest run's verified-payment-history prerequisite). Enabled, auto_post false. Changes no journal entry, ledger row or balance.

preflight.name: Waterview has no interest or bank reconciliation automation yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND process IN ('interest', 'bank_reconciliation')

preflight.name: both Waterview bank accounts exist
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM bank_accounts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND id IN ('829b287e-3d9f-4a4e-9eab-4ba437a329be', '238efceb-02de-4f8c-b5f5-dd078258c0f1')

expected_changes: Two community_accounting_automation rows for Waterview (interest, bank_reconciliation), enabled, auto_post false.
No journal entry, ledger row or balance changes.

verify.name: Waterview interest: 10%, 30 days, 4030, prior-month-end cutoff, never auto-posting
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND process = 'interest' AND enabled AND NOT auto_post AND settings->>'rate_bps' = '1000' AND settings->>'grace_days' = '30' AND settings->>'income_account_number' = '4030' AND settings->>'calc_cutoff' = 'prior_month_end'

verify.name: Waterview bank reconciliation covers Operating and Savings, never auto-posting
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND process = 'bank_reconciliation' AND enabled AND NOT auto_post AND jsonb_array_length(settings->'bank_account_ids') = 2
